headline: Fortinet (FTNT) Lifted 2026 Guidance, Is The Stock Now Too Expensive?
summary: Fortinet (FTNT) drew fresh investor attention after reporting second quarter 2026 results and issuing new guidance, including a full year 2026 revenue outlook of US$8.02b to US$8.18b with 19% year over year growth. See our latest analysis for Fortinet. Fortinet’s share price has climbed strongly over the year, with a 90 day share price return of 39.95% and a year to date share price return of 104.98%. The 1 year total shareholder return of 114.60% points to powerful longer term momentum...
